@UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.class-abilities.Item.oCNpE6bnZjPIdOO1]{Fascinate}

(Focus). Make a DC 12 CHA check. On a success, you transfix all targets in near whose LV is equal to or less than 1 + half your level (round down). If you fail, excluding focus, you can't use this again until you rest.
